name: Expense tracking and budgeting web app

mentions.name: Expense tracking and budgeting web app
mentions.description: A personal web application for expense tracking and budgeting, replacing the author's existing Google Sheets solution and being built as a Golang learning project. Core features include exploratory data analysis of expenses and expense forecasting, with a planned later-stage conversational interface for basic CRUD operations, chatting with the data, and running simulations based on hypothetical scenarios.
mentions.audience: Explicitly for the author's own use: "a web application that I will primarily use for expense tracking and budgeting."
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm migrating my current Google Sheets solution to a web application that I will primarily use for expense tracking and budgeting.

evidence.value: I'm migrating my current Google Sheets solution to a web application that I will primarily use for expense tracking and budgeting.
